select count(t.id) from tickets t
where status = 'waiting'

select count(t.id) from tickets t
where status = 'called'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'online'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'break'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'offline'

SELECT 
    t.number AS "Номер билета",
    s.name AS "Сервис",
    to_char(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Время создания",
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') - t.created_at))/60, 2) AS "Ожидание (мин)",
    CASE 
        WHEN t.status = 'waiting' THEN 'Ожидает'
        WHEN t.status = 'deferred' THEN 'Отложен'
        ELSE t.status
    END AS "Статус",
    COALESCE(t.defer_reason, 'Нет причины') AS "Причина"
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.status in ('waiting', 'deferred')
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC;

SELECT 
    s.name AS "Услуга",
    CASE 
        WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN 'Предоставляется'
        WHEN s.status = 'inactive' THEN 'Не предоставляется'
        ELSE 'Неизвестно'
    END AS "Статус"
FROM services s;

SELECT 
    s.name AS "Сервис",
    COUNT(t.id) AS "Билетов в ожидании"
FROM tickets t
JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.id
WHERE t.status = 'waiting'
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY "Билетов в ожидании" DESC;

WITH base_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
        COUNT(t.id) AS served_count,
        percentile_cont((${percentile:raw}::numeric / 100.0)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS percentile_wait,
        percentile_cont((${percentile:raw}::numeric / 100.0)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60) AS percentile_service,
        percentile_cont((${percentile:raw}::numeric / 100.0)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS percentile_total
    FROM tickets t
    JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
    WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
      AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
      AND (
          'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
          OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      )
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно')
)
SELECT
    operator_name AS "Сотрудник",
    served_count AS "Этапов закрыто",
    ROUND(percentile_wait::numeric, 2) AS "P${percentile:raw} ожид. (мин)",
    ROUND(percentile_service::numeric, 2) AS "P${percentile:raw} обслуж. (мин)",
    ROUND(percentile_total::numeric, 2) AS "P${percentile:raw} сумм. (мин)",
    CASE WHEN percentile_wait <= ${kpi_p90_wait:raw}::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "KPI ожид.",
    CASE WHEN percentile_service <= ${kpi_p90_service:raw}::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "KPI обслуж.",
    CASE WHEN percentile_total <= ${kpi_p90_total:raw}::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "KPI сумм."
FROM base_stats
ORDER BY "Этапов закрыто" DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(
    ROUND(
        100.0 * count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
              AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
        ) / NULLIF(count(*), 0),
        1
    ),
    0
) AS closed_stage_percent
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
  );

WITH called_tickets AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'completed' AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Этап завершен успешно'
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'redirected' AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Этап перенаправлен'
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'cancelled' THEN 'Отменено'
            WHEN t.status = 'called' THEN 'В обслуживании сейчас'
            ELSE 'Не завершено / прочее'
        END AS outcome
    FROM tickets t
    JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
    WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
      AND (
          'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
          OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      )
)
SELECT
    outcome AS "Исход",
    count(*) AS "Этапов",
    ROUND(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "Доля, %"
FROM called_tickets
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY "Этапов" DESC;

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
    t.window_id AS window_id,
    COALESCE(w.name, 'Неизвестно') AS window_name,
    COUNT(*) AS suspicious_count,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)))::numeric, 1) AS avg_duration_seconds,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at))) AS min_duration_seconds,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at))) AS max_duration_seconds
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
LEFT JOIN windows w ON w.id = t.window_id
WHERE t.status = 'finished'
  AND t.completion_reason = 'completed'
  AND t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (t.finished_at - t.called_at) < INTERVAL '1.5 minutes'
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно'), t.window_id, w.name
ORDER BY suspicious_count DESC, avg_duration_seconds ASC;

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AS time_from,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AS time_to
), clipped_periods AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
        GREATEST(osp.started_at, bounds.time_from) AS started_at,
        LEAST(COALESCE(osp.ended_at, bounds.time_to), bounds.time_to) AS ended_at,
        CASE osp.status
            WHEN 'offline' THEN 0
            WHEN 'online' THEN 1
            WHEN 'break' THEN 2
        END AS status_code
    FROM operator_status_periods osp
    JOIN bounds ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = osp.operator_id
    WHERE osp.started_at < bounds.time_to
      AND COALESCE(osp.ended_at, bounds.time_to) > bounds.time_from
      AND (
          'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
          OR osp.operator_id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      )
), points AS (
    SELECT started_at AS event_time, operator_name, status_code
    FROM clipped_periods
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ended_at AS event_time, operator_name, status_code
    FROM clipped_periods
)
SELECT
    event_time AS "time",
    operator_name AS metric,
    status_code AS value
FROM points
ORDER BY metric, "time";
